query.where: portname = 'Panama Canal' AND date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND date <= DATE '2024-12-31'

notes: Rows below are the attributes objects returned by the service, stored verbatim (values unmodified, sorted by date as returned under orderByFields). All 731 calendar days 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31 are present (365 days in 2023 + 366 in leap-year 2024); no missing dates, no duplicates. The portid 'chokepoint2' was confirmed from the service's own rows for portname 'Panama Canal' before the dated query was run. n_total counts all transits recorded at the chokepoint per day (booked and unbooked); it is an observed transit count, NOT the ACP's daily booking-slot limit — the two series differ and are never interchanged.
